Messages.Author: ReverendRevolver
Messages.Body:
Ona phone, but for clarity, yseult says " when yseult plays a card that requires melpominee, you may draw an additional card. Discard afterword"
Blood weakens says"cards that require disciplines are not replaced until the end of the action or (blahblahblah)"

So, no bw out means yseult plays lily prelude and you draw two, drop one. Blood weakens is out, she plays lily prelude, she draws an additional(one more than zero) and discards afterwords.

Thats how i read it, at least. Drawing an additional card is in this case stated on ysuelt. So, you dont get your replqcement, but you get to daw and dicard per her text.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Name: Blood Weakens
Cardtype: Event
Gehenna. Do not replace until a vampire commits diablerie.
Cards minions play in an action that require any Disciplines are not replaced until the end of the current action or until any Methuselah's hand is empty (whichever comes first). Any vampire who commits diablerie is immune to this effect until the next Gehenna card is played.

Name: Yseult
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Daughter of Cacophony
Group: 3
Capacity: 6
Discipline: FOR MEL PRE
Sabbat: When Yseult plays a card that requires Melpominee [mel], you may draw an additional card. Discard afterward. Yseult cannot block vampires with capacity above 4.

Draw the extra card when you'd replace the card. This is to be fixed in later cardtexts.

Messages.Author: Timo
Messages.Body:
You replace t the end of the action. Not the end of the turn.

And I have another question which happen last week with a similar effect (with learjet).

We played it like we had to replace 1 card, discard down, replace another, discard down etc. Is it correct ?

Name: Learjet
[KMW:C, KoT:PM2]
Cardtype: Equipment
Cost: 1 pool
Vehicle.
Each time you draw to replace a card this minion played as an acting minion, you may draw an additional card (discard afterward). A minion may have only one vehicle.
Artist: John Bridges

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
Yseult & Learjet should function in the same way.

The logic is:

Do I draw to replace now?
If NO then ignore effect.
If YES, then choose 1 or 2 cards to draw. (may draw an additional card).
Is my number of cards in hand above my handsize? Yes = Discard cards required. No = continue play.
